title: Data-driven macroscopic dynamics of complex networks using Topological Data Analysis and the Equation-Free Method
summary: In this work, we present a computational framework for exploring and analyzing the macroscopic dynamics of complex agent-based network models by integrating Topological Data Analysis with the Equation-Free Method. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, we apply it to Erdős--Rényi-type random networks. Central to our approach is a Topological Data Analysis-based filtration process driven by the density of activated network nodes (agents), from which we extract a coarse-grained macroscopic topological observable.
